shortDescription: Module to manage Virtual Machines in oVirt/RHV

options.name: affinity_group_mappings
options.description: Mapper which maps affinity name between VM's OVF and the destination affinity this VM should be registered to, relevant when C(state) is registered.

options.name: affinity_label_mappings
options.description: Mapper which maps affinity label name between VM's OVF and the destination label this VM should be registered to, relevant when C(state) is registered.

options.name: allow_partial_import
options.description: Boolean indication whether to allow partial registration of Virtual Machine when C(state) is registered.

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: ballooning_enabled
options.description: If I(true), use memory ballooning. Memory balloon is a guest device, which may be used to re-distribute / reclaim the host memory based on VM needs in a dynamic way. In this way it's possible to create memory over commitment states.

options.name: bios_type
options.description: Set bios type, necessary for some operating systems and secure boot. If no value is passed, default value is set from cluster. NOTE - Supported since oVirt 4.3.

options.name: boot_devices
options.description: List of boot devices which should be used to boot. For example C([ cdrom, hd ]). Default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: boot_menu
options.description: I(True) enable menu to select boot device, I(False) to disable it. By default is chosen by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: cd_iso
options.description: ISO file from ISO storage domain which should be attached to Virtual Machine. If you have multiple ISO disks with the same name use disk ID to specify which should be used or use C(storage_domain) to filter disks. If you pass empty string the CD will be ejected from VM. If used with C(state) I(running) or I(present) and VM is running the CD will be attached to VM. If used with C(state) I(running) or I(present) and VM is down the CD will be attached to VM persistently.

options.name: clone
options.description: If I(yes) then the disks of the created virtual machine will be cloned and independent of the template. This parameter is used only when C(state) is I(running) or I(present) and VM didn't exist before.

options.name: clone_permissions
options.description: If I(yes) then the permissions of the template (only the direct ones, not the inherited ones) will be copied to the created virtual machine. This parameter is used only when C(state) is I(running) or I(present) and VM didn't exist before.

options.name: cloud_init
options.description: Dictionary with values for Unix-like Virtual Machine initialization using cloud init.

options.name: cloud_init_nics
options.description: List of dictionaries representing network interfaces to be setup by cloud init. This option is used, when user needs to setup more network interfaces via cloud init. If one network interface is enough, user should use C(cloud_init) I(nic_*) parameters. C(cloud_init) I(nic_*) parameters are merged with C(cloud_init_nics) parameters.

options.name: cloud_init_persist
options.description: If I(yes) the C(cloud_init) or C(sysprep) parameters will be saved for the virtual machine and the virtual machine won't be started as run-once.

options.name: cluster
options.description: Name of the cluster, where Virtual Machine should be created. Required if creating VM.

options.name: cluster_mappings
options.description: Mapper which maps cluster name between VM's OVF and the destination cluster this VM should be registered to, relevant when C(state) is registered. Cluster mapping is described by the following dictionary:

options.name: comment
options.description: Comment of the Virtual Machine.

options.name: cpu_cores
options.description: Number of virtual CPUs cores of the Virtual Machine. Default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: cpu_mode
options.description: CPU mode of the virtual machine. It can be some of the following: I(host_passthrough), I(host_model) or I(custom). For I(host_passthrough) CPU type you need to set C(placement_policy) to I(pinned). If no value is passed, default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: cpu_pinning
options.description: CPU Pinning topology to map virtual machine CPU to host CPU. CPU Pinning topology is a list of dictionary which can have following values:

options.name: cpu_shares
options.description: Set a CPU shares for this Virtual Machine. Default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: cpu_sockets
options.description: Number of virtual CPUs sockets of the Virtual Machine. Default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: cpu_threads
options.description: Number of threads per core of the Virtual Machine. Default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: custom_compatibility_version
options.description: Enables a virtual machine to be customized to its own compatibility version. If 'C(custom_compatibility_version)' is set, it overrides the cluster's compatibility version for this particular virtual machine.

options.name: custom_emulated_machine
options.description: Sets the value of the custom_emulated_machine attribute.

options.name: custom_properties
options.description: Properties sent to VDSM to configure various hooks. Custom properties is a list of dictionary which can have following values:

options.name: delete_protected
options.description: If I(yes) Virtual Machine will be set as delete protected. If I(no) Virtual Machine won't be set as delete protected. If no value is passed, default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the Virtual Machine.

options.name: disk_format
options.description: Specify format of the disk. If C(cow) format is used, disk will by created as sparse, so space will be allocated for the volume as needed, also known as I(thin provision). If C(raw) format is used, disk storage will be allocated right away, also known as I(preallocated). Note that this option isn't idempotent as it's not currently possible to change format of the disk via API. This parameter is considered only when C(template) and C(storage domain) is provided.

options.name: disks
options.description: List of disks, which should be attached to Virtual Machine. Disk is described by following dictionary.

options.name: domain_mappings
options.description: Mapper which maps aaa domain name between VM's OVF and the destination aaa domain this VM should be registered to, relevant when C(state) is registered. The aaa domain mapping is described by the following dictionary:

options.name: exclusive
options.description: When C(state) is I(exported) this parameter indicates if the existing VM with the same name should be overwritten.

options.name: export_domain
options.description: When C(state) is I(exported)this parameter specifies the name of the export storage domain.

options.name: export_ova
options.description: Dictionary of values to be used to export VM as OVA.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: force
options.description: Please check to I(Synopsis) to more detailed description of force parameter, it can behave differently in different situations.

options.name: force_migrate
options.description: If I(true), the VM will migrate when I(placement_policy=user-migratable) but not when I(placement_policy=pinned).

options.name: graphical_console
options.description: Assign graphical console to the virtual machine.

options.name: high_availability
options.description: If I(yes) Virtual Machine will be set as highly available. If I(no) Virtual Machine won't be set as highly available. If no value is passed, default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: high_availability_priority
options.description: Indicates the priority of the virtual machine inside the run and migration queues. Virtual machines with higher priorities will be started and migrated before virtual machines with lower priorities. The value is an integer between 0 and 100. The higher the value, the higher the priority. If no value is passed, default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: host
options.description: Specify host where Virtual Machine should be running. By default the host is chosen by engine scheduler. This parameter is used only when C(state) is I(running) or I(present).

options.name: host_devices
options.description: Single Root I/O Virtualization - technology that allows single device to expose multiple endpoints that can be passed to VMs host_devices is an list which contain dictionary with name and state of device

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the Virtual Machine to manage.

options.name: initrd_path
options.description: Path to an initial ramdisk to be used with the kernel specified by C(kernel_path) option. Ramdisk image must be stored on either the ISO domain or on the host's storage.

options.name: instance_type
options.description: Name of virtual machine's hardware configuration. By default no instance type is used.

options.name: io_threads
options.description: Number of IO threads used by virtual machine. I(0) means IO threading disabled.

options.name: kernel_params
options.description: Kernel command line parameters (formatted as string) to be used with the kernel specified by C(kernel_path) option.

options.name: kernel_params_persist
options.description: If I(true) C(kernel_params), C(initrd_path) and C(kernel_path) will persist in virtual machine configuration, if I(False) it will be used for run once.

options.name: kernel_path
options.description: Path to a kernel image used to boot the virtual machine. Kernel image must be stored on either the ISO domain or on the host's storage.

options.name: kvm
options.description: Dictionary of values to be used to connect to kvm and import a virtual machine to oVirt.

options.name: lease
options.description: Name of the storage domain this virtual machine lease reside on. Pass an empty string to remove the lease. NOTE - Supported since oVirt 4.1.

options.name: lun_mappings
options.description: Mapper which maps lun between VM's OVF and the destination lun this VM should contain, relevant when C(state) is registered. lun_mappings is described by the following dictionary:

options.name: memory
options.description: Amount of memory of the Virtual Machine. Prefix uses IEC 60027-2 standard (for example 1GiB, 1024MiB). Default value is set by engine.

options.name: memory_guaranteed
options.description: Amount of minimal guaranteed memory of the Virtual Machine. Prefix uses IEC 60027-2 standard (for example 1GiB, 1024MiB). C(memory_guaranteed) parameter can't be lower than C(memory) parameter. Default value is set by engine.

options.name: memory_max
options.description: Upper bound of virtual machine memory up to which memory hot-plug can be performed. Prefix uses IEC 60027-2 standard (for example 1GiB, 1024MiB). Default value is set by engine.

options.name: migrate
options.description: If I(true), the VM will migrate to any available host.

options.name: multi_queues_enabled
options.description: If `true`, each virtual interface will get the optimal number of queues, depending on the available virtual Cpus.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Virtual Machine to manage. If VM don't exists C(name) is required. Otherwise C(id) or C(name) can be used.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: next_run
options.description: If I(true), the update will not be applied to the VM immediately and will be only applied when virtual machine is restarted. NOTE - If there are multiple next run configuration changes on the VM, the first change may get reverted if this option is not passed.

options.name: nics
options.description: List of NICs, which should be attached to Virtual Machine. NIC is described by following dictionary.

options.name: numa_nodes
options.description: List of vNUMA Nodes to set for this VM and pin them to assigned host's physical NUMA node. Each vNUMA node is described by following dictionary:

options.name: numa_tune_mode
options.description: Set how the memory allocation for NUMA nodes of this VM is applied (relevant if NUMA nodes are set for this VM). It can be one of the following: I(interleave), I(preferred) or I(strict). If no value is passed, default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: operating_system
options.description: Operating system of the Virtual Machine, for example 'rhel_8x64'. Default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine. Use the M(ovirt.ovirt.ovirt_vm_os_info) module to obtain the current list.

options.name: placement_policy
options.description: The configuration of the virtual machine's placement policy. If no value is passed, default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine. Placement policy can be one of the following values:

options.name: placement_policy_hosts
options.description: List of host names.

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: quota_id
options.description: Virtual Machine quota ID to be used for disk. By default quota is chosen by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: reassign_bad_macs
options.description: Boolean indication whether to reassign bad macs when C(state) is registered.

options.name: rng_device
options.description: Random number generator (RNG). You can choose of one the following devices I(urandom), I(random) or I(hwrng). In order to select I(hwrng), you must have it enabled on cluster first. /dev/urandom is used for cluster version >= 4.1, and /dev/random for cluster version <= 4.0

options.name: role_mappings
options.description: Mapper which maps role name between VM's OVF and the destination role this VM should be registered to, relevant when C(state) is registered. Role mapping is described by the following dictionary:

options.name: serial_console
options.description: I(True) enable VirtIO serial console, I(False) to disable it. By default is chosen by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: serial_policy
options.description: Specify a serial number policy for the Virtual Machine. Following options are supported. C(vm) - Sets the Virtual Machine's UUID as its serial number. C(host) - Sets the host's UUID as the Virtual Machine's serial number. C(custom) - Allows you to specify a custom serial number in C(serial_policy_value).

options.name: serial_policy_value
options.description: Allows you to specify a custom serial number. This parameter is used only when C(serial_policy) is I(custom).

options.name: smartcard_enabled
options.description: If I(true), use smart card authentication.

options.name: snapshot_name
options.description: Snapshot to clone VM from. Snapshot with description specified should exist. You have to specify C(snapshot_vm) parameter with virtual machine name of this snapshot.

options.name: snapshot_vm
options.description: Source VM to clone VM from. VM should have snapshot specified by C(snapshot). If C(snapshot_name) specified C(snapshot_vm) is required.

options.name: soundcard_enabled
options.description: If I(true), the sound card is added to the virtual machine.

options.name: sso
options.description: I(True) enable Single Sign On by Guest Agent, I(False) to disable it. By default is chosen by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the Virtual Machine be running/stopped/present/absent/suspended/next_run/registered/exported/reboot. When C(state) is I(registered) and the unregistered VM's name belongs to an already registered in engine VM in the same DC then we fail to register the unregistered template. I(present) state will create/update VM and don't change its state if it already exists. I(running) state will create/update VM and start it. I(next_run) state updates the VM and if the VM has next run configuration it

options.name: stateless
options.description: If I(yes) Virtual Machine will be set as stateless. If I(no) Virtual Machine will be unset as stateless. If no value is passed, default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: storage_domain
options.description: Name of the storage domain where all template disks should be created. This parameter is considered only when C(template) is provided. IMPORTANT - This parameter is not idempotent, if the VM exists and you specify different storage domain, disk won't move.

options.name: storage_error_resume_behaviour
options.description: If the storage, on which this virtual machine has some disks gets unresponsive, the virtual machine gets paused. These are the possible options, what should happen with the virtual machine at the moment the storage becomes available again.

options.name: sysprep
options.description: Dictionary with values for Windows Virtual Machine initialization using sysprep.

options.name: template
options.description: Name of the template, which should be used to create Virtual Machine. Required if creating VM. If template is not specified and VM doesn't exist, VM will be created from I(Blank) template.

options.name: template_version
options.description: Version number of the template to be used for VM. By default the latest available version of the template is used.

options.name: ticket
options.description: If I(true), in addition return I(remote_vv_file) inside I(vm) dictionary, which contains compatible content for remote-viewer application. Works only C(state) is I(running).

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: timezone
options.description: Sets time zone offset of the guest hardware clock. For example C(Etc/GMT)

options.name: tpm_enabled
options.description: If `true`, a TPM device is added to the virtual machine.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the Virtual Machine. Default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine. I(high_performance) is supported since Ansible 2.5 and oVirt/RHV 4.2.

options.name: usb_support
options.description: I(True) enable USB support, I(False) to disable it. By default is chosen by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: use_latest_template_version
options.description: Specify if latest template version should be used, when running a stateless VM. If this parameter is set to I(yes) stateless VM is created.

options.name: virtio_scsi_enabled
options.description: Enable Virtio SCSI support.

options.name: virtio_scsi_multi_queues
options.description: Number of queues for a Virtio-SCSI controller, possible values: -1 - Indicates that the queues will be automatically set. 0 - Indicates that the Virtio SCSI multi-queue will be disabled. >0 - Number of Virtio SCSI queues to use by virtual machine.

options.name: vmware
options.description: Dictionary of values to be used to connect to VMware and import a virtual machine to oVirt.

options.name: vnic_profile_mappings
options.description: Mapper which maps an external virtual NIC profile to one that exists in the engine when C(state) is registered. vnic_profile is described by the following dictionary:

options.name: volatile
options.description: Indicates that this run configuration will be discarded even in the case of guest-initiated reboot.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.

options.name: wait_after_lease
options.description: Number of seconds which should the module wait after the lease is changed.

options.name: watchdog
options.description: Assign watchdog device for the virtual machine. Watchdogs is a dictionary which can have following values:

options.name: xen
options.description: Dictionary of values to be used to connect to XEN and import a virtual machine to oVirt.
